speaker: A1QJX8U3IIL5XQ
text: Good morning!

speaker: A33RFOT34Z5DNC
text: Good morning

speaker: A1QJX8U3IIL5XQ
text: How are you doing today?

speaker: A33RFOT34Z5DNC
text: Great thanks!  How are you?

speaker: A1QJX8U3IIL5XQ
text: I'm good, thanks!  Today I am informing people about a charity called Save the Children.  Have you heard of them?

speaker: A33RFOT34Z5DNC
text: I don't think so.

speaker: A1QJX8U3IIL5XQ
text: They are an international organization who help protect children's rights as well as providing relief and support in developing countries

speaker: A33RFOT34Z5DNC
text: I see.  A worthy cause indeed.

speaker: A1QJX8U3IIL5XQ
text: They definitely are!  They are also very transparent about where their donations go which is something I always like to see in a charity.

speaker: A33RFOT34Z5DNC
text: Yes, that's a very important attribute.

speaker: A1QJX8U3IIL5XQ
text: 86% goes directly to program services, 9% to fundraising, and only 5% goes to management and general accounts

speaker: A33RFOT34Z5DNC
text: Seems like a valid distribution.

speaker: A1QJX8U3IIL5XQ
text: How often do you donate to charity?

speaker: A33RFOT34Z5DNC
text: I do not.

speaker: A1QJX8U3IIL5XQ
text: Let me ask you this then; how much money do you typically spend on coffee, tea, and/or soft drinks in a week?

speaker: A33RFOT34Z5DNC
text: I don't buy beverages when I'm out.  I do buy coffee to make at home and I do buy canned drinks for home/work use as well. I cannot afford to guy extraneous beverages.

speaker: A1QJX8U3IIL5XQ
text: Would you be willing to forgo your canned drinks you purchase at the grocery store for a week and donate to help save a child's life?

speaker: A33RFOT34Z5DNC
text: No, I would not.  As it is, I've already cut back on cable, now I use over the air antenna, and just about all other expenses that I can think of.

speaker: A1QJX8U3IIL5XQ
text: Wow.  You will continue drink your coffee at home while there are children starving around the world and not think twice about it?

speaker: A33RFOT34Z5DNC
text: Yes, with absolutely no guilt.  I realize that there are people suffering but as I say, right now, any way I can eliminate an expense would go to paying off my debt.  Then, I would gladly look into donating to a worthwhile charity like yours.

speaker: A1QJX8U3IIL5XQ
text: You could very easily donate ANY portion of the $2.00 you will potentially make doing this right now, and not lose anything.  Is THAT something you would do?

speaker: A33RFOT34Z5DNC
text: Yes, I will donate $1.00.

speaker: A1QJX8U3IIL5XQ
text: Awesome.  Thank you so much!  That $1.00 will go further than you think in helping children.
